decision.title: Gym Year Card vs Month Card over 13 months
decision.description: Compare the total payments required to maintain gym access for a 13‑month window when choosing either a 12‑month year‑card priced at USD 600 or a month‑to‑month card priced at USD 60 per month, with both plans granting identical gym access and no additional fees.
decision.originalInput: Compare a gym year card costing USD 600 per 12 months with a month card costing USD 60 per month over exactly 13 months. Both plans provide the same gym access. Compare actual payments needed to cover that window, including a full renewal payment when needed. These are all prices; there are no signup fees or per-visit charges. Do not amortize the annual payment, assume a partial refund, or introduce workout frequency or time per visit.

tags.name: Upfront affordability
tags.description: Does paying a larger sum now fit your current budget?

targets.consideration: Can you comfortably allocate USD 600 at the start?
Would spreading USD 60 each month be easier on your cash flow?

tags.name: Usage consistency
tags.description: How steady do you expect your gym attendance to be over the next year?

targets.consideration: If you plan to attend regularly, does the year‑card lock in access without worrying about monthly renewals?
If your attendance might vary month‑to‑month, does a month‑card let you pause or stop without losing a prepaid amount?

tags.name: Changing needs
tags.description: Do you anticipate changes in your schedule, location, or fitness goals that could affect gym use?

targets.consideration: If your circumstances might shift, are you comfortable committing to a full year?
Does a month‑to‑month plan give you the flexibility to adapt if your needs change?

tags.name: Renewal terms
tags.description: What are the implications of automatic renewal or the need to manually renew each month?

targets.consideration: Does the year‑card automatically renew after 12 months, and are you okay with that?
Do you prefer to manually renew each month to retain full control over continuation?

tags.name: Access requirements
tags.description: Is uninterrupted gym access important, or can you tolerate occasional gaps?

targets.consideration: Does having a single payment for a full year guarantee continuous access without worrying about lapses?
Would you be comfortable with the possibility of a gap if you forget to renew a month‑card?

facts.subscriptionCostComparison: Year Card costs $1,200.00 and Month Card costs $780.00 over 13 months.
